messages:
lin: Quick sync — proposing we unfreeze the runtime pin for a limited rollforward to runtime 2.15 tomorrow during the change window so we can test q5_2 quantized model performance in canary. Need sign-off on rollback plan and release notes.

maya: What's the primary risk vector here? kernel reorder or allocator changes? :thinking_face:

nate: The main diffs are allocator heuristics and one attention kernel tweak. We ran unit + perf harness on longseq and shortseq; memory looks stable but the q5_2 codepath touches a different matmul path. I want canary-only for 4 hours before broadening.

lin: Agreed. Window proposed: 03:00-04:30 UTC so it hits APAC off-peak. deploybot, can you schedule the change window and create a canary rollout?

deploybot: Scheduled change window for 2100060000-2100065400 UTC. Canary rollout created: canary/runtime-2-15-q5_2. To trigger: `deploybot canary create runtime 2.15 --route canary/runtime-2-15-q5_2 --percentage 5`

irene: I'll own smoke tests. Checklist: health endpoints, kv-cache hits, generation latency P50/P95, token accuracy baseline on 10 eval prompts, and SDK compatibility. I'll post results in this thread.

sam: SDK note — clients need SDK >= 1.8.0 for the new runtime feature flags (header propagation). We'll include migration note in release notes and a short snippet for bump: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.8.0`

maya: Also confirm that Dedicated customers with strict pin policies can opt-out automatically? We shouldn't override pinlists.

nate: We won't. Router respects customer pinlists. For rollback, plan is: 1) scale canary to 0, 2) pin runtime back to 2.14.3 in deploybot pinlist, 3) purge caches on affected nodes, 4) trigger redeploy. I'll write exact commands.

lin: Please add a quick automatic-triage rule: if error rate >3% or avg tail latency increases by >50% for 5m, auto-roll back. deploybot, can we wire that?

deploybot: Automation rule added: `if (error_rate > 0.03 || tail_latency_pct_change > 0.5) for 5m -> execute rollback: scale canary to 0; update pinlist runtime=2.14.3; notify #incidents`

irene: Smoke tests started now on canary. Quick interim: kv-cache hit rate 98%, P50 latency +8% (expected), P95 +12% (still under SLO), model outputs match baseline on 9/10 prompts (one slight token drift). Capturing logs.

sam: That token drift — can you paste the example? We need to see if it's a deterministic generation shift or sampling nuance. Also I'll draft release notes with a migration caveat about minor token diffs for quantized paths.

nate: Sample router change needed — update `router.json` mapping for q5_2 variant. Example snippet:```json
{"model_alias": "q5_2", "runtime": "2.15", "fallbacks": ["q5_2-fp16","gptx-small"]}
```

maya: If canary stays green for 4 hours we can roll to 20% then 100% across non-pin customers. Dedicated customers will be notified and require opt-in.

lin: thumbs-up from me assuming smoke tests finish cleanly. @sam can you own the release note blurb + migration instructions? @nate please paste exact rollback CLI. @irene keep posting test artifacts.

sam: I'll post release_notes/drafts later today and drop a short customer-facing blurb for the console banner. :memo:

nate: Rollback CLI (copy/paste): `deploybot pin add runtime 2.14.3 --reason "rollback runtime 2.15 canary regressions" && deploybot canary scale --route canary/runtime-2-15-q5_2 --percentage 0 && deploybot nodes purge-cache --selector canary-2-15`

irene: Final smoke summary (4h): errors 0.9%, tail latency +10% stable, 10/10 prompt matches after small sampling seed fix. All green from infra and infra-sre.

maya: :thumbsup: Proceed with canary rollforward tomorrow at 03:00 UTC. Make sure the release notes mention the SDK bump and the fallback mapping.

lin: Thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread open during the window. If anything unexpected we hit the rollback CLI and ping #incidents.
